story_overview: MSVBench story 09 (German Fairy Tales). On a cold winter day, the queen sat by the palace window sewing for her daughter. The queen thought Snow White was dead and was happy for a while. The prince told her what had happened and asked her to marry him. Snow White agreed, and they held a grand wedding. The queen also attended. When she saw that the bride was Snow White, she fainted in anger and eventually died of jealousy and bitterness. Snow White and the prince lived happily ever after.

video_prompts: Daytime, inside the palace, peaceful and serene, snowflakes falling outside the window, a sewing box and unfinished clothes on the windowsill, warm indoor lighting. The queen sits on a chair by the window, focused on her sewing, with a gentle expression, snowflakes falling outside behind her. On a cold winter day, the queen sat by the palace window sewing for her daughter. Medium shot, front view, eye level shot.

Daytime, inside the palace, quiet, snowflakes falling outside the window, a sewing box and unfinished clothes on the windowsill, warm indoor lighting. The queen's finger is pricked by the needle, blood dripping onto the snowflakes on the windowsill. She frowns slightly, looking surprised. Suddenly, she accidentally pricked her finger with the needle, and blood dripped onto the snowflakes drifting in through the window. Close up, front view, eye level shot.

Daytime, inside the palace, quiet, snowflakes falling outside the window, a sewing box and unfinished clothes on the windowsill, warm indoor lighting. The queen clasps her hands together, eyes closed in prayer, with a devout expression, snowflakes continuing to fall outside. The queen looked at the blood and snow and began to pray, wishing for her daughter to have skin as white as snow, cheeks as red as blood, and hair as black as ebony. Medium close up, front view, eye level shot.

Daytime, palace garden, sunny, blooming flowers and a fountain in the garden, bright sunlight. Snow White stands in the garden, the queen beside her. Snow White has fair skin, rosy cheeks, and lustrous black hair. The queen looks pleased. When the queen's daughter grew up, she indeed possessed the beautiful appearance her mother had wished for, so she named her Snow White. Full shot, high-angle shot.

Daytime, inside the palace, quiet, the queen's portrait hanging on the wall, flowers on the table, soft lighting. Snow White stands before her mother's portrait, looking sorrowful with tears in her eyes. However, Snow White's mother passed away when she was young. Medium shot, side view, eye level shot.

Nighttime, queen's chamber, dark and mysterious, black curtains on the wall, magic mirror on the table, dim candlelight. The new queen stands before the magic mirror, looking smug. Her face is reflected in the mirror. Later, the king remarried. The new queen was beautiful but evil-hearted. She had a magic mirror and often asked it who the fairest woman in the world was, and the mirror always answered that it was her. Medium close up, front view, low-angle shot.

Nighttime, queen's chamber, dark and mysterious, black curtains on the wall, magic mirror on the table, dim candlelight. The new queen looks shocked. Snow White's face is reflected in the mirror. But as Snow White grew up, the mirror told the queen that Snow White was fairer than her. Close up, front view, eye level shot.

Daytime, inside the palace, tense, the queen standing before the throne, the servant kneeling before her, bright lighting. The new queen looks angry, pointing at the servant. The servant bows his head, kneeling in fear. The queen was filled with jealousy and ordered the servant to take Snow White into the forest and kill her. Medium shot, side view, high-angle shot.

Daytime, forest, quiet, dense trees, fallen leaves on the ground, natural lighting. The servant faces away from the camera, Snow White standing before him. The servant waves her away, and Snow White looks grateful. But the servant couldn't bring himself to do it and let Snow White go. Medium shot, rear view, eye level shot.

Daytime, forest, quiet, dense trees, fallen leaves and a deer's corpse on the ground, natural lighting. The servant holds a dagger, looking somber, crouching beside the deer's corpse to handle its entrails. Afterward, he stayed in the forest, hunted a deer, and brought back its entrails as proof. Medium close up, side view, eye level shot.

Daytime, forest, quiet, dense trees, the dwarfs' house visible in the distance, natural lighting. Snow White walks through the forest, looking lost. The dwarfs' house is faintly visible in the distance. Snow White got lost in the forest and eventually came upon the dwarfs' house. Wide shot, rear view, bird's eye view shot.

Daytime, dwarfs' home, cozy, simple furniture and a fireplace in the room, warm firelight. The dwarf stands before Snow White, looking kind. Snow White sits on a chair, relaxed. The dwarfs were very kind and let Snow White stay in their home, taking care of her. Medium shot, front view, eye level shot.

Daytime, queen's chamber, smug, black curtains on the wall, magic mirror on the table, bright lighting. The new queen stands before the magic mirror, looking smug with a smirk. The queen thought Snow White was dead and was happy for a while. Medium close up, front view, eye level shot.

Nighttime, queen's chamber, dark and mysterious, black curtains on the wall, magic mirror on the table, dim candlelight. The new queen looks shocked. Snow White's face is reflected in the mirror again. But when she asked the mirror, it told her Snow White was still alive and fairer than ever. Close up, front view, eye level shot.

Daytime, dwarfs' home, tense, simple furniture and a fireplace in the room, natural lighting. The new queen, disguised as an old woman, stands behind Snow White, tightening a lace around her neck. Snow White looks pained, struggling to break free. So, the queen decided to act herself. The first time, she disguised herself as an old woman and tried to strangle Snow White with a poisoned lace. Medium close up, side view, eye level shot.

Daytime, dwarfs' home, tense, simple furniture and a fireplace in the room, natural lighting. The dwarf crouches beside Snow White, looking anxious, holding an antidote. Snow White slowly wakes up. But the dwarfs found her and revived her. Medium shot, front view, eye level shot.

Daytime, dwarfs' home, tense, simple furniture and a fireplace in the room, natural lighting. The new queen, disguised as an old woman, stands behind Snow White, inserting a poisoned comb into her hair. Snow White looks pained. The second time, the queen disguised herself as an old woman again and poisoned Snow White with a poisoned comb. Medium close up, side view, eye level shot.

Daytime, dwarfs' home, tense, simple furniture and a fireplace in the room, natural lighting. The dwarf crouches beside Snow White again, looking anxious, holding an antidote. Snow White slowly wakes up. But the dwarfs revived her again. Medium shot, front view, eye level shot.

Daytime, dwarfs' home, tense, simple furniture and a fireplace in the room, natural lighting. The new queen, disguised as a farmer's wife, stands before Snow White, offering her a poisoned apple. Snow White looks innocent, taking a bite. The third time, the queen disguised herself as a farmer's wife and poisoned Snow White with a poisoned apple. Medium close up, side view, eye level shot.

Daytime, dwarfs' home, sorrowful, simple furniture and a glass coffin in the room, natural lighting. The dwarf stands by the glass coffin, weeping sadly. Snow White lies inside the coffin, looking peaceful. This time, the dwarfs couldn't revive her and had to place her in a glass coffin. Medium shot, front view, eye level shot.

Daytime, forest, quiet, dense trees, the dwarfs' house visible in the distance, natural lighting. The prince walks through the forest, looking around in confusion. The dwarfs' house is faintly visible in the distance. Many years later, a prince also got lost in the forest and came upon the dwarfs' house. Wide shot, rear view, bird's eye view shot.

Daytime, dwarfs' home, quiet, simple furniture and a glass coffin in the room, natural lighting. The prince touches the glass coffin, gazing at Snow White's face. He saw Snow White's beauty in the glass coffin and fell in love with her. Medium close up, front view, eye level shot.

Daytime, dwarfs' home, cozy, simple furniture and a glass coffin in the room, natural lighting. The prince stands before the dwarf, looking earnest. The dwarf nods in agreement. He asked the dwarfs to let him take Snow White, and they agreed. Medium shot, front view, eye level shot.

Daytime, dwarfs' home, surprised, simple furniture and a glass coffin in the room, natural lighting. The prince helps Snow White sit up. The poisoned apple falls from her mouth, and Snow White slowly opens her eyes, looking surprised. As the prince prepared to take Snow White away, the poisoned apple fell from her mouth, and she woke up. Medium close up, front view, eye level shot.

Daytime, palace, festive, lavishly decorated wedding venue filled with guests, bright lighting. The prince and Snow White stand at the wedding altar, looking happy. The new queen stands below, looking shocked, then faints backward. The prince told her what had happened and asked her to marry him. Snow White agreed, and they held a grand wedding. The queen also attended. When she saw that the bride was Snow White, she fainted in anger and eventually died of jealousy and bitterness. Snow White and the prince lived happily ever after. Full shot, high-angle shot.
